title: Chilli Cheese Paniyaram

items: 25 grams cheese of choice, i use amul

method: Add batter and chopped green chillies in the bowl and stir together
In a paniyaram pan, fill half with dosa batter then add in the small cheese cube and top with a little more batter, dont fill all the way it will rise

caption:
Chilli Cheese Paniyaram 

Nutrition: 
C: 31 | F: 17 | P: 12
Calories: 368 per serve 
Serves 1

Ingredients
1.5 tsp sesame oil 
80 grams idli/dosa batter 
2 green chillies, chopped
25 grams cheese of choice, i use amul 

Method 
add batter and chopped green chillies in the bowl and stir together 
in a paniyaram pan, fill half with dosa batter then add in the small cheese cube and top with a little more batter, dont fill all the way it will rise 
cover and cook then turn it and cook for a few minutes till done
i serve mine with tomato chutney :)
